claims.description: Selector lists and supported relationship combinators match elements.

notes.text: Selector lists plus descendant, child, adjacent-sibling, and general-sibling combinators have parity coverage.

claims.description: Supported attribute, structural, state, and functional pseudo-class selectors participate in matching.

notes.text: Matching includes case-insensitive terminal HTML attribute selectors, scoped compound `:where()` and `:is()` selectors normalized independently of host matcher quirks, `:not()`, `:has()`, structural selectors, and supported state pseudo-classes. `::before` and `::after` are routed to generated-content measurement rather than matched as ordinary elements.

claims.description: Specificity and source-order ties determine the winning supported rule.
Unsupported selectors route through the configured unsupported CSS policy.

notes.text: Unsupported CSS and selectors are ignored with one actionable warning per distinct input by default; strict throw and silent ignore policies remain configurable.
